messages:
miriam: Quick sync - thinking of a tiny "span aggregation" at ingest to collapse lots of sub-200ms sibling spans to cut storage and smooth billing spikes. Thoughts?

devon: How do you pick candidates? Name whitelist + same trace+parent?

miriam: Exactly. Whitelist by span.name, same trace_id+parent_id+effective_route, start times within 200-300ms. Emit synthetic span with merged_count, raw_sum_cost, merge_bucket.

anish: Concerns: masking retries/hedges and changing percentiles. Safety rules needed.

sam: Also avoid streaming/grpc flows. We need explicit dont_merge flag and streaming/error checks.

miriam: Safety list: no-merge if error=true, streaming=true, duration>1s, different caller identity, or explicit dont_merge. Merge metadata includes merge_window_ms and merge_refs (bounded).

katie: For billing: store raw_sum_cost for audit and compute smoothed_cost for dashboards using per-tenant+route baseline with burst cap. Mark estimates when sampling inverse missing.

devon: Ops plan: canary in one region 2wks; measure ingest CPU, storage delta, percentiles top-100 flows, billing diff, false-positive rate.

miriam: Action items: prototype at gateway (me), baseline service (devon), billing compatibility (katie), dashboards (anish), canary candidates (sam).

ops-bot: created INF-8420 span-aggregation prototype (epic: obs-cost-optim).

sam: Add feature flag and per-route toggle for rollout.

miriam: Will write short RFC + sample queries tomorrow. Thanks :thumbsup:
